data.name: Skipped_one
data.value: {0} photo couldn't be read and was skipped.
data.comment: A message bar after an import; View list shows the file and why. {0} the number of photos ("1").

data.name: Skipped_other
data.value: {0} photos couldn't be read and were skipped.
data.comment: A message bar after an import; View list shows each file and why. {0} the number of photos ("3", "1,204").

data.name: UnsupportedFormat
data.value: Not a photo format Windows can read
data.comment: Why a file was skipped: Windows has no decoder for its format. A fragment after the file name, no final period.

data.name: DecodeFailed
data.comment: Why a file was skipped: its data is corrupt. A fragment, no final period.

data.name: AccessDenied
data.comment: Why a file was skipped: Windows denied access to it. A fragment, no final period.

data.name: FileNotFound
data.value: No longer there: moved, deleted or disconnected
data.comment: Why a file was skipped: it disappeared during the import. A fragment, no final period.

data.name: Other
data.comment: Why a file was skipped, when no better reason is known. A fragment, no final period.

data.name: EmptyFile
data.comment: Why a file was skipped: it has no data. A fragment, no final period; use your language's word or symbol for bytes.

data.name: Truncated
data.comment: Why a file was skipped: the file is cut short (an interrupted copy). A fragment, no final period.

data.name: NeedsExtension
data.value: Needs an extension from the Microsoft Store
data.comment: Why a file was skipped: Windows needs an extension from the Microsoft Store to read its format. It may be free or paid; another message bar names it, says which, and opens the Store. A fragment, no final period.

data.name: FileInUse
data.comment: Why a file was skipped: another app holds it locked. A fragment, no final period.

data.name: ImageTooLarge
data.comment: Why a file was skipped: the image is too large to decode. A fragment, no final period.

data.name: CloudFileOffline
data.value: In the cloud and not available offline
data.comment: Why a file was skipped: it is an online-only file of a cloud service and the PC is offline. A fragment, no final period.

data.name: CloudOnly
data.value: Only in OneDrive, not on this PC
data.comment: Why a file was skipped: it is only in OneDrive and the user chose not to download it. A fragment, no final period.
